replace_pause_with_stop.label: Replace Pause with Stop
replace_pause_with_stop.description: Forces Music Assistant to stop playback instead of pausing. Enable for some legacy streamers which are unable to pause/resume playback when streaming uPnP/DLNA.

respect_other_sources.label: Leave other sources playing
respect_other_sources.description: Do not send stop/pause to the device while it plays a source that is not Music Assistant (e.g. its own presets or inputs), and end the Music Assistant session when another source takes over the device. Requires a device that reports the URI it is playing.

manifest.description: Stream music to supported UPnP/DLNA-compatible devices.
